The '''New Republic Scout and Retrieval Vehicle/Repulsorlift''' (or '''SRV/R-1''') was a variant on the [[SRV-1 Scout and Retrieval Vehicle|SRV-1]]. With its [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] ability came a higher financial cost and a reduced carrying capability: Only two metric tons, compared to the SRV-1's three. In addition, the power generator was only able to power either the repulsorlift or the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] cannon at any one time, which forced the SRV/R-1 to stand still and fight when confronted, or retreat without being able to fire back.
